primary_question.question: Why is my Instant Rava Dosa too dense or dry?
evidence: Do not add water before mixing the dry ingredients, or lumps form more easily

related_questions.question: Why is my Instant Rava Dosa batter not right?
evidence: Do not make a thick dosa batter; rava dosa needs a thin batter to become lacy

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Instant Rava Dosa?
evidence: Do not let the oil smoke heavily

related_questions.question: Why does my Instant Rava Dosa stick or tear?
evidence: Do not flip or move too early, or the dosa will tear

related_questions.question: Why is my Instant Rava Dosa not crispy?
evidence: Do not lower the heat too much, or it will turn chewy instead of crisp
